Card Q&A.a: No, cards revealed from the top of your deck aren't considered to be “trashed from your deck,” so this card’s effect doesn’t trigger.
Card Q&A.q: Is this card’s inherited effect triggered by the activation of an effect that reads, “Reveal the top X cards of your deck... Trash the remaining cards.”?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Trash the top 2 cards of your deck. Then, return 1 card with [Demon Lord] in its traits from your trash to your hand.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When a card is trashed from your deck, gain 1 memory.
